title: The Fall and Judgment of Babylon
description: A mighty angel comes down from heaven and announces that Babylon the Great has fallen and become a dwelling place for demons. A voice from heaven calls God's people out of the city before the plagues strike her. The kings of the earth, the merchants, and the seafarers weep and mourn as they see the smoke of her burning, for in one hour all her wealth has been laid waste. Finally, a mighty angel lifts a stone as large as a millstone and throws it into the sea as a sign that Babylon will never be found again.
